<div class="card-body">
'''Yavin 4: Massassi War Room''' is a [[Light]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ヤヴィン４：マサッシ戦略司令室</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">リーダーがいてここを占領していれば、場に出ている全てのストームトルーパーとタイ・ファイターに対して、没収値－１。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここで戦闘を起こすと、戦闘運命数に＋１。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-139o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Yavin 4: Massassi War Room.

'''Light Side:''' If you occupy here with a leader present, all stormtroopers and TIE fighters on table are forfeit −1.

'''Dark Side:''' If you initiate a battle here, add 1 to battle destiny.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese Light uses occupy with a leader; English uses control with a leader here.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Yavin 4: Massassi War Room]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
